name: Micron Singapore advanced NAND wafer fab
summary: A new NAND wafer fab inside Micron's existing NAND manufacturing complex in Singapore, which Micron describes as the country's first double-story wafer fab. Groundbreaking took place in January 2026. The fab is designed to reach 700,000 square feet of cleanroom at full build-out and is expected to start wafer output in the second half of calendar 2028.

location.note: Within Micron's existing NAND manufacturing complex, which the release says also holds Micron's HBM advanced packaging facility.

metrics.note: Stated as US$24 billion (SG$31 billion) over 10 years.
Cleanroom the fab is designed to reach at full build-out.

sources.title: Micron Breaks Ground on Advanced Wafer Fabrication Facility in Singapore
Micron Technology, Inc. Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended September 3, 2026

notes: The release page header is dated 26 January 2026 and its dateline 27 January 2026, so the groundbreaking is recorded to the month.
